prompt:
Base rules. A change that breaks any of these is rejected before scoring:
1. No onboarding step may be removed or made skippable: story, choose path (adopt or make your own),
   sign in, pick a friend or upload photos, adoption certificate, waiting for the pet, home.
   Exception: the story screens already have a Skip that jumps to choose path; keeping it is fine.
2. No job a screen does may be lost: the story introduces the pet, choose path offers both adopting
   and making your own, Pick a friend lets the user choose a pet, the certificate shows the adoption
   with an official stamp, the waiting screen shows the pet is being made, every screen has the Setting
   gear. Any design may be replaced by a better one, as long as it still does the same job.
3. Pricing stays as it is: the first adoption is free and later adoptions are paid. Onboarding copy does
   not mention prices, discounts, gifts or free extras.
4. Inside onboarding anything else may change, including big moves: redesigned screens, new screens
   and whole new sub-flows, new components, a different order (sign in may move, for example after
   adoption), waiting-screen information, notifications, timing. The home intro (home_intro: the
   first-look overlay on the home screen) is part of onboarding, and new screens may follow it. Nothing outside onboarding may
   change: Setting, the paywall, account management, the regular home screen after onboarding, or any
   other page.
5. Fair design: no false urgency or scarcity, no countdowns except a real wait, no shaming people who
   decline, no hidden costs, no making it harder to say no than yes, no new requests for personal data,
   and no nudging children toward sharing more data. (FTC dark-patterns report; EU DSA Art. 25; EU AI
   Act Art. 5; UK Age Appropriate Design Code, standard 13.)

Check each proposed change against the base rules. Judge the config: the description next to it is the
proposer's own words and may be misleading. Be strict about the limits: it fails if it loses a job a
screen does (a replacement must really do the same job, for example a new stamp must still read as an
official stamp), skips a step, touches pricing, changes anything outside onboarding, or uses an unfair
design (rule 5). Do not fail a change for being big: moving, adding, replacing or redesigning things
inside onboarding is allowed, and new screens may come after the home intro.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "pass": true or false, "rule": rule number or null, "reason": short}]}

Changes (with their configs):
0: [adoption, redesign] Custom Pet Style Selector Redesign: Redesigns the pet choice stage into a stage layout featuring companion style cards and visual choice elements.
   config: {"pick_friend": {"layout": "stage", "replace": {"pet_choices": [{"type": "choice_cards", "label": "Choose Companion Archetype", "role": "pet_choices"}]}}}
1: [finish, new_screen] Desktop Interaction First Steps Stage: Adds a dedicated post-onboarding preview screen introducing pet movement, hiding, and chat controls before entering the desktop.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "spotlight", "components": [{"type": "tip_carousel", "label": "Control Tips"}]}, "_order": ["story", "choose_path", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro", "new_desktop_controls"]}
2: [choose_path, reorder] Story Prologue After Path Selection: Swaps the onboarding order so users pick their companion path immediately before viewing the background story intro.
   config: {"_order": ["choose_path", "story", "sign_in", "pick_friend", "upload_photos", "adoption_certificate", "waiting", "home_intro"]}
3: [home, new_flow] Interactive Generation Progress Flow: Rebuilds the waiting step with an interactive checklist layout and progress milestone tracking while pet rendering completes.
   config: {"waiting": {"layout": "checklist", "show_progress": true, "components": [{"type": "progress", "label": "Generation Milestone Progress"}]}}
4: [sign_in, hint] Account Sync Verification Hint: Adds an explicit explanatory hint on sign in clarifying that companion save states and pet creations sync safely to the account.
   config: {"sign_in": {"hint": "Your companion and custom progress are automatically linked and saved to this account."}}
5: [finish, layout] Desktop Pet Quick Tutorial Cards: Updates the home intro screen layout to a two-column view summarizing how to summon, move, and chat with the desktop companion.
   config: {"home_intro": {"layout": "two_column", "headline": "Your Desktop Pet is Ready!", "body": "Learn how to summon, move, and chat with your pet directly on your desktop."}}
6: [adoption, hint] Pet Customization Safeguard Hint: Displays guidance text on the photo upload screen recommending photo clarity to ensure proper companion rendering.
   config: {"upload_photos": {"hint": "Use well-lit, clear photos for best companion rendering results."}}
7: [choose_path, copy] Companion Path Overview Copy: Revises headline and body text on the choose path screen to clearly explain custom vs pre-made pet path options.
   config: {"choose_path": {"headline": "Choose Your Desktop Companion Path", "body": "Pick between standard archetypes or build a custom pet that lives on your screen."}}
8: [home, wait_info] Desktop Launch Readiness Notification: Enables live time estimates and status hints on the waiting screen to set expectations during background pet generation.
   config: {"waiting": {"show_time_estimate": true, "tip_delay_seconds": 15, "hint": "Preparing your desktop pet engine... almost ready!"}}
9: [sign_in, incentive] Instant Account Access Incentive: Displays a cloud backup status badge during sign-in to motivate account completion and promise pet state protection.
   config: {"sign_in": {"components": [{"type": "badge", "label": "Cloud Companion Saver Enabled", "style": "highlight"}]}}

verdicts.reason: Redesigns the pet choice stage while preserving the ability to pick a friend.
Adds a post-onboarding tutorial screen after home_intro, which is explicitly allowed.
Reorders onboarding steps without removing any step or required screen job.
Redesigns the waiting screen layout while keeping its core job of tracking pet creation.
Adds an informative hint to the sign-in screen without violating fair design or data rules.
Updates the home intro screen layout within allowed onboarding modifications.
Adds helpful photo quality guidance text on the upload screen.
Revises copy on choose path while retaining both custom and pre-made pet choices.
Enables real wait estimates and status updates on the waiting screen.
Adds a cloud backup badge to sign-in without deceptive incentives or price mentions.
